messages:
deploy-bot: Deploy scheduled for service=service-llm-route version=v2 at 1750065500. Rolling plan will use feature flag 'llmroute_v2' for gradual exposure. Health gate thresholds: 5xx > 0.5% OR p95 > 300ms => stop and alert. @oncall please ack.
Sam: Ack. I'll watch canary windows and traces. Who wants to own pin/unpin?
Lina: I'll own release notes and can trigger rollback if needed. Adding short changelog: 'v2: improved KV cache handling + batching optimizations; staged ff rollout.'
Ash: Suggest ramp steps: 0.05% internal -> 0.5% -> 5% -> 25% -> 100%. Note: session affinity might bias canary, watch consistency across buckets.
oncall: Confirm: flags are randomized routing for these cohorts, no sticky sessions by default. Creating dashboard alerts for model-mismatch >0.2%, 5xx >0.5%, p95 >300ms.
Sam: Proposed timing: pin v2 to cohort canary-1 at +10s, set llmroute_v2=0.05% at +30s, bump 0.5% @ +8m, 5% @ +18m, 25% @ +40m, 100% @ +70m. Manual rollback owner?
Lina: @Sam I'm primary for rollback if you can't act, :thumbsup:.
Jen: I'll run the eval harness at +12m and +30m to catch any quality regressions >1.5%.
Sam: Quick ops notes: `deployctl pin --service service-llm-route --version v2 --cohort canary-1` and FF flip via admin API: `curl -X PATCH "https://api.redwood.dev/flags/llmroute_v2" -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN" -d '{"percent":0.05}'`
Ash: If we see region skew in latency don't continue ramp; pause and diag.
oncall: Smoke tests at +5m and +15m scheduled, will post results here.
deploy-bot: Automation queued: pin v2 at 1750065510, set flag at 1750065530. Will post each toggle.
Sam: Noted. Watching logs and traces.
oncall: Smoke +5m: minor 502s from model-host-2 (3 occurrences), low volume. Investigating.
Sam: Seeing the 502s, holding ramp at 0.05% until model-host-2 stabilizes. Pausing automation.
Lina: Documenting hold in the release ticket and notifying product.
deploy-bot: Ramp paused by Sam at 1750065900 (operator hold). Further automated actions cancelled until manual resume.
Ash: I found model-host-2 had a transient probe failure (envoy timeout) and restarted; health checks are green now. Recommend resume to 0.5% and observe 10m.
oncall: Re-ran smoke tests – all clear.
Sam: Resuming: bump to 0.5% now, hold 10m, then proceed with next steps.
Jen: Eval after resume shows no meaningful quality drop. Proceeding.
Lina: Updating release summary to note hold and fix.
Sam: Continuing ramp as scheduled; will call rollback if alerts fire. Leaving thread open for real-time decisions. :eyes:
